title: EZPug Iron server link
description: The wire between a server’s EZPug core plugin and the orchestrator (decision 5). Generated from packages/protocol/src by scripts/protocol-schema.mjs; the C# twins in plugins/EZPug.Sdk/Generated are generated from this file.

Locale.description: A player’s language: German or English.

LocalizedText.description: A translated string: both languages, always.

MatchTeam.description: A match team as every event names one.

GameserverSource.description: Which provider and which server an event came from.

GameserverPlayer.description: A player as a gameserver sees one: SteamID64, in-game name, slot.

TeamScore.description: A score in team order, never winner first.

RoundWinner.description: Who took a round, and on which side.

PlayerRoundSummary.description: One player’s cumulative stats as of a round end.

PauseKind.description: Why a match is standing still.

ServerChatScope.description: Which window a chat line was said in.

GameserverEvent.description: The vocabulary (decision 4): the one language a server speaks to anyone. v1, byte-compatible with the platform’s.

MatchApiErrorCode.description: The Match API’s error vocabulary, as a command result names a reason.

WeaponSkin.description: A finish on a weapon, for one side.

SideLoadout.description: Everything one side of a loadout holds.

Loadout.description: A player’s cosmetics as the server applies them (decision 20).

RosterEntry.description: A rostered or pushed player: SteamID64, display name, locale, rating, rank, loadout.

Roster.description: A team as the request locks it.

MapPlanSides.description: Which side team A starts on, or `knife`.

MapPlan.description: One map to be played and how sides are decided.

GamemodeFlow.description: Who owns match flow on the server.

GamemodeRecords.description: What the server keeps of a match.

GamemodeSlots.description: How many people, in what shape.

GamemodeCapabilities.description: What the mode can do, as booleans the loader enforces.

PlayerCommandChargePeriod.description: What a charge is counted against.

PlayerCommandSpec.description: A player-scoped verb an sdk mode accepts, with its cooldown and charges.

LinkServerState.description: Where a server is in its life, as it reports it.

GamemodeCapability.description: One manifest capability, as a hello lists the ones a server can honour.

RoundBackup.description: A round backup as it crosses the link, up as written and down on restore.

ConsoleLine.description: One console line with the server’s uptime.

SequencedEvent.description: One vocabulary event with its per-server link sequence number.

AssignedGamemode.description: The manifest as resolved for one assignment: everything a server reads.

LinkCommand.description: A Match API command relayed verbatim, or the link’s own `console`.

LinkCommandStatus.description: What became of a command on the server.

PlayerCommandRefusal.description: Why a player’s command was refused.

LinkAckStatus.description: What the orchestrator answers per event.

ServerFrame.description: What a server sends the orchestrator.

OrchestratorFrame.description: What the orchestrator sends a server.
